newsitem.title: UK: Serco says MOD contract worth 190 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Serco says MOD contract worth 190 mln stg.

text.p: Serco Group Plc said on Wednesday that a 30 year contract from the Ministry of Defence to establish a new Joint Services Command and Staff College will be worth around 190 million stg at today's value.
A consortium known as Defence Management of Serco and John Laing Plc has been chosen as preferred bidder for the contract.

"The contract is probably worth more like 500 million (stg) for the 30 year period," Kevin Beeston, finance director at Serco told Reuters. But he said that at today's value the contract was worth around 190 million stg.

Serco, an industry and management service contractor, said the consortium will be required to provide the complete academic and residential facilities, including married residential accommodation, at the site near Swindon, southern England. It will will operate the facility, providing all of the maintenance and other support services.
